assertions.assertion: The patient presents with intermittent palpitations and episodes of dizziness that have persisted despite initial evaluation, raising concern for an underlying arrhythmia.
To capture the elusive nature of these symptoms and correlate them with cardiac rhythm disturbances, a long-term continuous ECG monitoring study is indicated.
The service is medically necessary to document and correlate the patient's reported arrhythmia concern with the observed cardiac rhythm disturbances.
The service was rejected under reason code PR-204, indicating that this specific procedure is not covered under the member's current benefit plan.
Please review the attached Explanation of Benefits for further details regarding this decision.
You have the right to appeal this determination.
To initiate an appeal, please submit a written request along with any supporting clinical documentation to our appeals department within the timeframe specified in your plan documents.
Failure to submit timely appeals may result in the loss of review rights.
